Commentary.Commentary: Right then! 213 is the target for England. It is not a big one once again but Ireland will remember the first game where England had faltered at the start but managed to win it. They have a few more runs than the last time. Let's see how the run chase pans out. Join us for the second essay in a short while.

After asked to bowl first, England were brilliant with the ball once again. Willey struck early and kept things tight along with his new bowling partner Reece Topley. Adil Rashid spun the web around the batters and took three wickets and kept things calm from his end. He became the first English spinner to have taken 150 ODI wickets in the process. James Vince too got a chance to bowl and he managed his first international wicket. Moeen Ali and Saqib bowled tightly too.

Ireland once again started on a poor note as they lost their openers early. They couldn't score runs freely either and kept losing wickets at regular intervals. They had lost half the side without reaching 100. However, Campher and Singh added 60-runs between them to stabilize things a little. Simi Singh was caught behind off Mahmood on 25 but Campher continued his good performance and with his successive half-century has helped Ireland get to a decent total.

Brilliant recovery from Ireland! What an innings from Campher and what a brilliant partnership along with McBrine. It has given Ireland a chance in this game. They looked down and out when they lost their 5 wickets quite early but Campher along with Singh and McBrine have helped Ireland get over 200.

OUT! CAUGHT! A wicket on the final ball of the innings. A very good bouncer from Topley. McBrine tries to get away from the firing line but the ball takes the bat and goes behind. Bairstow completes another catch and appeals along with the bowler. The umpire raises the finger and Topley finally has a wicket after a long, long wait.
Short and around off, McBrine pulls it towards deep mid-wicket and calls for two straight away.
Beaten! Very good bowling. On a good length and outside off, McBrine looks to swing at it but misses it.

DROPPED! Willey makes the ground but fails to hold on. Slower fuller ball around off, Young fails to read it and ends up chipping it towards mid off. Willey comes charging ahead from long off, makes the ground but fails to hold on. Topley will feel really unlucky.
Another dot! A bumper this time and Young goes for pull but ends up getting a bottom edge to the keeper.
A dot to begin the final over. Full and outside off, Young fails to make any connection.
Full ball on the pads, McBrine tries to flick but misses. The ball just misses the leg stump.

In the air... but safe in the end. A back of a length ball outside off, Young goes for pull but gets a top edge. The ball goes high in the air towards square leg. Bairstow calls for it and makes good ground but fails to catch it.
Full and on the pads, stroked to long on for a single by McBrine.
Craig Young is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A fine catch from Rashid but what a brilliant innings from Campher. Full and outside off, Campher looks to slam it over long off but ends up slicing it uppishly towards third man. Rashid comes charging ahead and takes a good tumbling catch. A top class knock comes to an end.
Full toss outside off, stroked to mid off for a single.
Full and outside off, Campher makes room and drives it to deep cover for a single.
On a length on middle, McBrine flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Short delivery on middle, McBrine looks to pull but misses it.
BEATEN! On a good length on middle, McBrine looks to swing at it but misses it. It misses the leg stump by a whisker.
Short of a length delivery on leg, McBrine looks to pull but misses it. It goes towards the keeper where Bairstow collects it safely.
Length delivery outside off, McBrine lofts it over covers. The batsmen get two runs.
Short delivery on middle, Campher pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
200 up for Ireland. Brilliant recovery led by the young Campher. Good length ball on the pads, Campher tucks it to fine leg and takes a single.
FOUR! Excellent finish to the over! Third boundary in the over. Reverses the fast bowler superbly. He sees that the third man is up in the ring and reverse sweeps this full ball for a boundary.
Full and outside off, McBrine drills it towards cover where Morgan makes a half stop. A single taken.
Good length ball around off, pushed to deep point for a single.

FOUR! Another one! This is superb from Campher. He is taking on the challenge and pushing Ireland towards a decent total. Full and around off, Campher makes room and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
FOUR! That is put away! Short delivery on middle, Campher pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Bouncer around off, McBrine ducks under it.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover for a run.

FOUR! Excellent from Campher. Back to back half tons. 2 ODIs in the career and half tons in both of them, against the world champions. Full and outside off, Campher moves inside and scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Full delivery on off, Campher looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Topley bowls a yorker on middle, Campher does well to dig it out.
On a length on middle, McBrine flicks it through square leg for a run.
Short delivery outside off, Campher cuts it over point. The fielder in the deep does well to stop it. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Short of a length delivery, Campher looks to pull but misses it.
Full delivery on middle, McBrine flicks it towards fine leg for a run.
FOUR! Nice shot! Full delivery on middle, McBrine lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
On a good length on middle, Campher looks to flick but gets it off the pads. It goes towards square leg. The batsmen cross ends. The umpire gives it as a leg bye.
Good length delivery on off, Campher keeps it out.
Full delivery on middle, Campher looks to drive but gets an inside edge. It goes towards fine leg. The batsmen cross ends.
On a length on middle, McBrine flicks it towards fine leg for a run.
Short of a length delivery, McBrine looks to pull but misses it.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, McBrine looks to cut but misses it.
On a length on middle, Campher flicks it through square leg for a single.
Good length ball outside off, McBrine cuts it down to deep point for a single.
Reece Topley is back on.
10 from the over, A good one for Ireland. Good length ball on middle, McBrine tucks it towards deep square leg and takes a single.
Shortish and around off, Campher hangs on the back foot and ramps it towards third man for a single.
Full and on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish and around off, pushed through  point for a single.

FOUR! Runs coming thick and fast for Ireland. Willey bangs it short and around middle, it is pulled down to deep square leg. There is a fielder in the deep bit it is wide of his reach. He tries to flick the ball inside the play but fails to do so. More than 100 runs for Campher without getting dismissed.
On the pads, Campher tucks it towards square leg and scampers back for two.
FOUR! Nicely ramped to third man fence. Good finish to the over! Short and wide outside off, McBrine stays on the back foot and guides it over the empty slip cordon for a boundary.
Short and outside off, Campher guides it to third man for a run.
Good length ball on middle, blocked back to the bowler.
RUN OUT CHANCE MISSED! Full ball on middle, McBrine flicks it towards mid on and calls for a single. Willey from mid on gets to the ball and fires the throw at the bowler's end but misses.
Andy McBrine is in now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Mahmood gets his first wicket. A good stand is broken. Good length ball outside off, Singh tries to run it down to third man but ends up getting a nick behind. Bairstow behind the wicket takes the easiest of catches.
FOUR! Full and on the pads, Singh tickles it nicely to the fine leg fence. 150 up for Ireland.
BEATEN! Short of a length delivery outside off, Campher looks to cut but misses it.
Full delivery on off, Campher drives it to covers.
Length delivery on middle, Singh flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick single.
On a good length and outside off, Singh leaves it alone.
On a good length on off, Singh blocks it off the front foot.
Short delivery on middle, Campher pulls it towards fine leg for a single.
Powerplay 3 is signalled. David Willey is back on.
Full and outside off, Campher times his drive superbly but can't beat mid off. Gets a single though as it is little wide of the man.
Good length ball around off, blocked off the front foot.
Landed around middle on a good length, Singh turns it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! EDGY! Good length ball outside off, Singh looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge. No slip in place and the ball races down to the third man fence. Fifty stand is up between the two. Very vital runs.
Good length ball around off, guided towards third man for a single.

An appeal for caught behind has been referred upstairs. Mahmood appealed but he wasn't too sure but Bairstow was and he convinced his skipper to go for it. Let's see if there's any nick. Flat line it is as the ball goes past the bat. So, the on-field decision stays.

NOT OUT! No nick at all. That was very far from the bat. England lose their 2nd review too. Good length ball outside off, Campher tries to cut but misses. Bairstow and Mahmood appeal but nothing from the umpire. Mahmood actually joined a bit late. Bairstow though convinces his skipper to take the review.  The replays roll in and show day light between bat and ball.
Tossed up around middle, pushed to long on for a single. Ali finishes another over in a jiffy.
Around off, blocked towards point.
Tossed up on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and on off, Campher strokes it back to the bowler.
Another fuller one, this one goes straight to mid off.
Fuller and around off, Singh pushes it through mid on for a single.
Full and outside off, Campher drills it nicely but straight to the cover fielder.
Another good length ball that is angled in, Campher this time blocks it out.
Slightly short and outside off, Singh runs it down wide of deep point. Single taken.
Appeal but that looked to be going down the leg side. A length ball angled in, Campher tries to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. They appeal but not out says the umpire.
Back of a length ball on middle, Singh pulls it down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish and around off, Campher cuts it to deep point nicely but only for a single.
Shortish and around off, cut to deep point for a single.
On middle, this one is stroked to long on for a run.
Quicker one around middle, once again Singh finds mid-wicket.
Another fuller one, once again Singh turns it towards the leg side.
Fuller and around middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Shortish and around off, Campher plays it to long on for a single
Length delivery on off, Campher taps it towards point for a single.
Mandatory Concussion test! Campher looks fine but the umpire wants the test done. They have called for the Drinks break as well.
Short delivery on middle, Campher looks to pull but gets hit on the helmet. It goes towards fine leg. The batsmen get two runs. The umpire gives it as leg byes.
On a good length on off, Campher blocks it off the front foot.
Full delivery on off, Campher drives it to covers.
Shortish and around off, Singh works it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller and around off, driven to the cover fielder.
Full and around off, driven firmly but straight to mid off.
Quicker one around off, pushed towards point by Campher and a loud no for the single.
Full and around off, defended back to the bowler.
Tossed up ball on off, pushed towards the cover fielder.
FOUR! That is put away! Short delivery on middle, Campher pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flighted delivery on off, Campher punches it through covers. The fielder in the deep does well to stop it with a dive just before the ropes. The batsmen get two runs.
Excellent spell from Rashid comes to an end. Slightly shortish and around off, Campher forces it to deep point for a single. 3 wickets for 34 in his 10 overs.
FOUR! Slammed down the ground! Tossed up fuller ball outside off, Campher slams it to the left side of the bowler who tries to catch but the ball whizzes over his hands and goes to the fence.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Ripper! Nice turn. Lands it around off and makes it turn away to beat the front foot defense of Campher.
Flatter one around off, blocked off the back foot.
Fuller and around off, pushed towards the cover fielder.
On middle, Campher flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Short delivery on off, Simi cuts it through point for a single.
On off, Campher punches it through mid on. The batsmen take a run.
Loopy delivery on middle, Singh drives it through mid on. The batsmen cross ends.
Full delivery on middle, Campher drives it through mid on for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Campher defends it off the back foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

NOT OUT! Impact outside off and wickets missing as well. Another tossed up ball outside off, Singh once again moves towards the off side and goes for the sweep. He misses and gets hit on the body. They appeal once again and the umpire says not out. This time Morgan refers it upstairs. The replays roll in and show that there is no bat involved but the impact is outside off. So Singh stays while England lose their review.

This one is referred upstairs by Morgan. Let's see what the replays show. Front foot is fine confirms the TV Umpire. No bat involved. What does Ball Tracking show? Impact outside and wickets missing too. So, not out decision stays and England lose a review.
Shortish around off, blocked towards point.
Huge appeal but not out says the umpire. They do not opt for the review.
FOUR! Swept away! Fullish and around off, Singh gets in front of the stumps and sweeps it firmly. The ball races away to the deep square leg fence.
On the pads, flicked towards the leg side for a quick run.
Full delivery on middle, Campher drives it through mid on for a single.
On off, Campher blocks it off the back foot.
BEATEN! Short delivery outside off, Campher looks to cut but misses it.
Loopy delivery on middle, Campher nudges it towards the leg side.
Flighted delivery on middle, Campher blocks it off the front foot.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Singh drives it through mid on for a single.
Full and outside off, this one is driven to the cover fielder.
Around off, blocked.
Shortish and around off, blocked off the back foot.
On the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, this time Campher cuts it through point and gets two.
Fuller and around off, Singh drives it firmly through the covers for a single.

NO BALL AND FOUR BYES! Quicker one down the leg side this time, the batsman misses his tickle and the keeper misses too and the ball races to the fence. It would've been called wide but the TV umpire confirms that it is a no ball. So Free Hit coming up.
WIDE! Loopy ball outside off, it turns further away as the batsman lets it go. Wided.
On off, Campher defends it off the back foot.
On middle, Campher blocks it off the back foot.
Loopy delivery on off, Singh plays it towards point. The batsmen cross ends.
Floated delivery on middle, Simi defends it off the back foot.
Flighted delivery on off, Singh keeps it out.
Tossed up delivery on off, Simi Singh blocks it back towards the bowler.
Quicker one outside off, left alone.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Moeen Ali is back on.
Around off, little quicker too. Campher is on the back foot to work it on the leg side for a single.
Full and around off, this one is driven towards mid on.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

OUT! CAUGHT! Soft dismissal. Rashid has another one, his 150th ODI wicket. He sees the batsman setting up for sweep and fires it outside off, Tucker goes for the sweep but ends up getting a top edge. It balloons towards short fine leg where Topley accepts the simple chance. Tucker too has to go after getting a start.
Simi Singh is the new batsman in.
Wide outside off, Campher lets it go to the keeper.
FOUR! This time Campher finds the gap through point. Shortish length outside off, Campher stays on the back foot and punches it through point.
Fuller and outside off, Campher times it superbly but Morgan dives to his left and makes a great stop.
Beaten! That kept a little low. Good length delivery outside off, Campher tries to defend but misses.
Another back of a length ball around off, Campher is on his toes to defend it out.
Shortish and around off, Campher pushes it towards point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. Just a single from the over.
Loopy ball on off, blocked off the front foot.
Full and outside off, Tucker drives well but finds mid off.
Slower through the air and just outside off, Tucker pushes it towards point.
Quicker one on middle, Tucker pushes it back to Rashid.
Flatter outside off, punched to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! On a good length on off, Tucker looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes wide of the keeper towards third man for a boundary.
On a length on off, Campher looks to drive but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man. The batsmen take a run.
Outside off, Campher leaves it alone.
Full delivery on off, Tucker drives it through covers for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Tucker blocks it off the front foot.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Tucker looks to defend but misses it.

Campher is off the mark in a streaky manner! Another tossed up ball, this one is just outside off, Campher looks to drive but gets an inside edge. The ball goes past the stumps and towards fine leg. Two taken before the fielder can get to the ball.
Curtis Campher is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust. Tector wanted to clear the mid on fielder but he fails to get the desired elevation. A tossed up ball on middle, Tector looks to slam it over mid on but fails to get timing and elevation both. It goes straight to Mahmood's bucket hand. Half the Irish side is back to the hut quite early once again.
Tossed up ball just outside off, Tector comes down the track to defend but misses to get hit on the pads.
Quicker one on the pads, Tucker works it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full and around off, this time Tucker finds mid off.
Floated on off, pushed back to the bowler.
On a good length on middle, Tector blocks it off the back foot.
Good length delivery on off, Tector keeps it out.
On a length on off, Tucker taps it towards point for a single.
FOUR! Just helped it on its way! Short and down the leg side. Tucker rocks back and pulls it by rolling his wrists nicely. It reaches the fine leg fence.
Length delivery on middle, Tector flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On a good length on off, Tector defends it to point.
Tossed up ball on middle, Tucker takes a big strike forward and blocks it onto the pitch.
Full and outside off, Tector drives it past the diving cover fielder. A single as there is a protection in the deep.
Quicker one around off on a shortish length, Tector pushes it back to the bowler.
Around off, defended towards the leg side.
Very full around off, this one is driven nicely but straight to mid off.
Floated on off, pushed towards the off side.
Two from the first over of Mahmood. It's shortish length around off, Tector tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick run.
Fuller and around off, pushed to mid off.
Bouncer now but little too short and Tector ducks it away easily.
Good length ball around off, Tucker opens the bat face and runs it down to third man for a single.
Good length ball around off, Tector forces it towards point for a quick run.
Fuller and around off to begin the spell by Mahmood. Tector pushes it towards cover.
Quicker one around off, Tucker blocks it towards mid-wicket.
Full delivery on middle, Tector drives it through mid on for a single.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Tucker flicks it through square leg. The batsmen cross ends.
On off, Tucker offers a solid defense on this one.
Loopy delivery on middle, Tucker flicks it through square leg. The batsmen get two runs.
Flighted delivery on off, Tucker defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Clobbered! Full and outside off, Tector slams it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Shortish and around off, Tector pushes it towards point and takes a single.
WIDE! Full delivery down the leg side, Tector looks to flick but misses it.

Full delivery on middle, Tucker comes down the track and looks to hammer it. He does not time it well and it goes over the mid on fielder. The batsmen get three runs as the fielder does well to stop it.
Short delivery on middle, Tector pulls it through mid-wicket. The batsmen cross ends.
On a good length on off, Tector keeps it out.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Tucker looks to flick but gets an inside edge. It goes towards square leg. The batsmen get two runs.
On middle, Tucker keeps it out.
On off, Tucker blocks it off the back foot.
Floated delivery on middle, Tector looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. Rashid appeals but the umpire shakes his head.
Flighted delivery on middle, Tector defends it off the back foot.

FOUR! That hit the umpire's head but still raced to the fence. That was hit powerfully. A loosener from Rashid. High full toss, Tector hammers it down the ground, it hits the umpire who takes the evasive action but the ball hits his hat and takes off the sunglasses and still goes to the long on fence.
Fuller and around off and middle, Tucker pushes it towards mid off.
Short and outside off, pushed towards point.
Beaten! Tucker once again takes a step forward as he tries to defend this good length ball outside off but gets beaten this time.
Around off on a good length, Tucker comes forward and keeps it out.
Shortish and just outside off, Tector is on the toes as he forces it towards deep cover for a single.
Good length ball around off, Tector pushes it towards point.
Lorcan Tucker is the new batsman in.

DRINKS! The hosts are in total control of this game. They have picked four wickets and put Ireland under pressure. On the other hand, Ireland have started again poor with the bat. They have lost their main players and they need a solid partnership to get back in this game.

OUT! STUMPS RATTLED! Fantastic from Rashid. O'Brien is bamboozled. The wrong'un has done the trick for Rashid. Loopy ball around off, O'Brien is drawn forward and he looks to defend but the ball sneaks through and shatters the stumps behind. Ireland slip further as Kevin takes the long walk back to the pavilion.
Full delivery on off, Tector drives it through covers for a single.
On middle, O'Brien drives it through mid on. The batsmen cross ends.
Floated delivery on off, O'Brien defends it off the front foot.
Full delivery on middle, Tector drives it through mid on for a single.
BEATEN! Tossed up delivery outside off, Tector looks to defend but misses it due to the turn on this one.
Adil Rashid is into the attack.
O'Brien is up and running with a couple! A short ball on middle, he pulls it towards deep square leg and scampers back for two.
Goes fuller this time, O'Brien forces it towards mid off.
Short around off again, pushed towards the cover fielder.
Shortish outside off, O'Brien pushes it towards point.
Kevin O'Brien is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The skipper it out of here! James Vince has his first international wicket. Short and wide outside off, Balbirnie looks to cut but at the last second pulls out but he is little too late as the ball takes the bottom of the bat and goes behind. A simple chance for Bairstow. Balbirnie was starting to look good but has been removed.
Good length ball around off, Tector looks to defend but gets it towards square leg off the inner half of the bat. A single taken.
Flighted delivery on middle, Tector drives it through mid on for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Tector drives it back towards the bowler.
On off, Tector guides it towards point.
Loopy delivery on off, Tector keeps it out.
Flighted delivery on middle, Balbirnie sweeps it towards fine leg. The batsmen cross ends.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Tector flicks it towards square leg for a run.
A dot to end the over! Another good length ball around off, Tector pushes it towards mid off.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Shortish and around off, guided down to third man for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Around off on a good length, pushed towards  mid on.
He starts with a fuller ball on the pads, Tector flicks it towards deep square leg and gets couple.
James Vince into the attack! Surprise, surprise! Surely, no one saw that coming! Let's see what he got under his hat.
FOUR! Swept away! Fuller and outside off, Balbirnie gets in position and sweeps it powerfully towards the deep square leg fence.
Shortish and around middle, pushed towards mid on.
On off, pushed towards point for a single.
Quicker one around off, this one is turned towards square leg.
Flatter and just outside off, worked towards mid-wicket.
Ali starts with a fuller one around off, Tector pushes it towards the cover fielder.
Moeen Ali is into the attack.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Very full ball around off, Balbirnie keeps it out.
Good length ball around off, pushed between covers and mid off and a single taken.
Another solid punch but it is in the reach of the mid on fielder but before he can get to the ball, a single taken.
Good length ball on middle, blocked off the front foot.
FOUR! First boundary for Balbirnie! He is starting to look good now! Slightly fuller and around off and middle, Balbirnie punches it down the ground powerfully. It races away to the long on fence.
WIDE! Willey tries to bowl a bumper but the line  is down the leg side. Wided by the umpire.
Powerplay 2 is signalled. Maximum of 4 fielders will be outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Fuller and on middle, this one is stroked to mid on. Powerplay 1 ends and the scoreboard tells you who is dominating so far. IRELAND ARE 20/2.
Driven firmly but good stop from Ali at mid off. Full and just outside off, Balbirnie strokes it well but Ali at mid off makes a good stop.
Slightly short and just outside off, Balbirnie looks to cut but ends up getting a bottom edge.
Full and around off, Balbirnie drives it well but can't beat Topley.
On the pads, Balbirnie flicks but finds mid-wicket.
Good length ball around off, pushed back to the bowler.
A leave to end the over! Full and outside off, Tector shoulders arms. The ball dies down as it reaches Bairstow behind the wicket.
Connects this fuller ball well but finds mid off does Tector.
Another play and a miss! Good length ball just outside off, Tector pokes to get beaten.
Another quick single by Balbirnie as he gently pushes this good length ball around off towards the cover fielder.
Good length ball around middle, pushed towards the leg side.
OHHH! Beautiful bowling! Lands this length ball around off and makes to come back in a hint. Balbirnie looks to defend but the ball sneaks through the gap between bat and pad.
Fuller and around off, this one is pushed to mid-wicket.
Beaten again! Topley will think he is slightly unlucky that he hasn't got a wicket in this innings so far. A good length ball outside off, Tector once again looks to drive but misses.
Quick run! Fuller and around off, Balbirnie pushes it towards mid off and takes a quick run as Moeen Ali is slow to get to the ball.
Outside off, Balbirnie lets it go to the keeper.
Fuller and around off, pushed towards point.
Back of a length ball around middle and leg, Balbirnie looks to defend but misses to get hit high on the pad.
First runs in ODIs for Tector! A good length ball on the pads, he tickles it towards fine leg and takes two.
Fuller and around off, Tector drives it well but straight to the cover fielder.
Wide outside off on a good length, this time Tector lets it go to the keeper.
Beaten! Loose from Tector. A fuller one from Willey which is wide outside off, Tector reaches out and looks to drive but fails to connect.
Good length ball on middle, Tector keeps it out.
Harry Tector is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Stirling departs and Willey has another one but the credit for this wicket should be equally given to Banton. Fuller and outside off, Stirling throws his bat at it but does not time it too well. It flies off the thick outside edge wide of the man at point. Banton there throws himself to the left side and plucks the ball with both hands.
A single to end the over as this time Stirling works this shortish ball on the body towards mid-wicket.
Stirling is living dangerously! Another play and a miss from him. A length ball just outside off, he is beaten again.
Landed on a good length around middle, worked towards mid-wicket for a run.
Beaten! This is excellent bowling from both these fast bowlers. Slightly shorter and outside off, Balbirnie is on the back foot as he tries to punch but misses.
Driven firmly but finds the cover fielder. Full and around off, Balbirnie connects it well but straight to the fielder.
Short of a length around off, pushed towards the off side off his back foot.
Beauty to end the successful over! Just outside off on a fullish length. Stirling looks to drive but is beaten.
The skipper is off the mark! A length ball around off, Balbirnie pushes it towards mid off and calls for a quick single.
Andy Balbirnie, the Ireland skipper, is the new batsman in.

OUT! PLUMB! Willey gets the breakthrough and Delany goes for a duck! A good length ball around off and middle, there is just a hint of movement into the batsman as Delany tries to work it on the leg side. He misses to get hit on the pads. Willey and the England players appeal. The umpire raises his finger. Delany goes to his senior partner and thinks for the review but opts against it. The replays roll in and show that Ireland would've lost the review as he was caught dead in front of the wickets.
Good length ball on the pads, Stirling tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Another Stirling attempt of driving the ball away from the body is failed as he ends up getting a thick inside edge towards mid on.
This is excellent bowling from Willey! Just about misses the outside edge. A good length ball around off, Stirling looks to defend but misses.
Maiden from Topley! Short and outside off, Delany is patience enough to let this one go to the keeper.
Delany still searching for his first run. 10 balls for nothing so far. Shortish length on off, Delany is on the back foot to force it towards the off side.
Shortish around off, pushed towards the off side.
Beaten! Gets slightly closer to the off pole and fuller too as Delany looks to put bat on ball only to get beaten.
Wide outside off, Delany lets it go to the keeper.
Good length ball around off, punched towards the cover fielder.
A solid defense to finish the over as Willey bowls this fuller one around off. Maiden from Willey.
Another one outside off on a good length, this time Stirling shoulders arms.
Beaten! Another play and a miss! In the channel outside off, slight away movement too. Stirling pokes but is beaten.
Willey goes full and around off, Stirling gives it a charge and looks to slam it but manages an inside edge on the pad.
Slightly short and around middle and leg, Stirling looks to defend but misses to get hit on the pad.
Fuller and outside off from Willey, Stirling once again reaches out to drive but ends up getting it off the inner half of the bat towards the leg side.
Good length ball around off, blocked off the front foot.
Beaten! Gets the line and length both right and bowls it just outside off on a good length. Delany pokes at it but gets beaten.
Another good length ball around off, Stirling guides it to third man for a run.
FOUR! Through the cover this time! Good length ball around off, Stirling drives it through the covers and it reaches the fence quickly.
Just behind fuller length this time, Stirling looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.

FOUR! Welcome into the ODI side of England says  Stirling to Topley. Topley starts his spell with a fuller ball around off, Stirling stays put and pushes it down the ground. The ball races away to the fence at long off.
Recce Topley to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Just two from the over! Good start from Willey. He bowls the last ball full and around off, Delany keeps it out.
Landed around off on a good length, Delany pushes it towards mid off.
A leave first up as Delany tries to set himself in as Willey bowls this good length ball outside off.
Stirling is off the mark! A length ball around off and middle, Stirling  works it towards square leg for a run.
Beauty! A good length ball around off. It pitches and moves away as Stirling tries to drive on the up but misses.
Goes full and outside off, Stirling chases it and looks to drive but the ball takes a thick inside edge and goes to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Ireland are underway with an extra as Willey starts with a ball down the leg side. Wided by the umpire.

Time for the action to begin! The two Ireland openers, Paul Stirling and Gareth Delany stride out to open the innings. The English players take their positions on the field too. David Willey with the ball first up. Here we go...

Eoin Morgan, the England skipper, says they don't have any problem in chasing or bowling first. Adds the wicket has a bit of moisture in it. On the first ODI, Morgan says that he is happy with the performance from the first ODI but feels that there will be some level of rustiness as the series starts after quite a long break. Tells they have made one change as Tom Curran has been replaced by Reece Topley.

Andy Balbirnie, the Ireland skipper, says they will bat first. Tells that it is the used wicket and hence the decision. Adds that they will need to bat better than the last game. Mentions Josh Little comes in for Barry McCarthy.
England Playing XI - Jason Roy, Jonny Bairstow (WK), James Vince, Eoin Morgan (C), Sam Billings, Tom Banton, Moeen Ali, David Willey, Reece Topley (IN FOR TOM CURRAN), Adil Rashid, Saqib Mahmood.

Ireland Playing XI - Paul Stirling, Gareth Delany, Andrew Balbirnie (C), Harry Tector, Kevin O'Brien, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Curtis Campher, Simi Singh, Andy McBrine, Josh Little (IN FOR BARRY MCCARTHY), Craig Young.
TOSS - Ireland won the toss and elected to bat first.

Just a day's gap and England are ready to test Ireland again. They bludgeoned them in the first outing comfortably and would look to repeat the same to seal the series here only. Ireland, on the other hand, would be eager to put the last match's performance behind and try to win the game and keep the series alive. Let's see how things pan out. Will England make any change or play the same XI? How about Ireland? Well, stay with us to find out as we bring the toss and team updates in a short while.
